propositions: Bugs filed during epic execution but outside its hierarchy are incorrectly ignored at close; a deterministic caused_by floor is needed to block epic close when an open/in_progress bug records caused_by targeting the epic or any descendant.

Current direct-children gate cannot detect in-scope deliverable defects that lack reciprocal links; a deterministic candidate filter (open/in_progress bugs created after epic's first in_progress transition OR linked any-relation-any-depth to subtree) with 32-candidate ceiling supplies candidates for further adjudication.

A single-turn haiku relevance screen forced-choice (A: defect in epic's deliverable; B: pre-existing/adjacent; C: unrelated) with citation classifies candidates before verifier review, riding model-class config + prompt caching, warm-then-fan-out orchestration.

The verifier must adjudicate candidates by checking store-grounded disposition signals: supersedes/duplicates links (either direction) OR reasoned pre-existence/supersession prose in description/comments; bare 'out of scope' does not satisfy; close_class is ineligible.

Incomplete screen results (model failure, truncation beyond 32-candidate ceiling, or malformed verdicts) degrade safely to open with logged reason and never fabricate false A-verdicts; full tally recorded in completion sidecar for audit and calibration.
